data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 海岛宿所的展翅流风
data.action: 坐在窗台上摇晃着长腿，金发双马尾在晚风中扬起，一手扶着窗框，一手拉着吊带向你欢快地打着招呼，充满无拘无束的飞翔活力。
data.location: 反重力鞋合宿宿舍海景木窗前，窗外是泛着碎银月光的黑夜大海
data.lighting: 窗外皎洁的海上月光照亮金发双马尾，室内暖光从背后勾勒出匀称紧致的运动体态
data.mood: 空竞少女的洒脱与野性，海风拂面般的畅快自由与明朗魅力
data.description: 反重力鞋合宿宿舍海景木窗前，窗外是泛着碎银月光的黑夜大海。坐在窗台上摇晃着长腿，金发双马尾在晚风中扬起，一手扶着窗框，一手拉着吊带向你欢快地打着招呼，充满无拘无束的飞翔活力。 她微微抬眸轻语——“前辈！即使到了睡觉时间，蕾娜的心也还在天空中翱翔呢！今晚……要不要一起来蕾娜的梦里飞翔呢？”
data.promptProse: Perched on the open wooden windowsill of her seaside dormitory at night, Lena Liechtenauer swings her bare legs in a sky-blue breathable sports-mesh racerback camisole and sporty side-striped boyshorts. Holding the window frame as sea breeze lifts her blonde hair and flashing a bright grin with sparkling purple eyes, she is framed by the moonlit sea.
data.animaCaption: Perched on the wooden dormitory windowsill swinging her bare legs in a sky-blue sports-mesh racerback camisole and striped boyshorts, she steadies one hand on the frame and greets the viewer with a breezy, radiant grin. Silver ocean moonlight behind her meets warm indoor lamplight.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sky-blue and white breathable sports-mesh racerback camisole paired with sporty side-striped sleep boyshorts.
